name: Conductor
tagline: Control microcontroller hardware in plain language: detected components become tools an LLM can call.

awards: Best Hardware Hack presented by Embedder

problem: Getting embedded hardware working is slow for people with ideas but little firmware experience.
solution: A script generates working boilerplate for declared components, and an MCP server exposes them as tools so Claude can drive the hardware from natural language.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask in words and a connected component responds.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Hardware Hack presented by Embedder” among 122 submissions.
Generates code deterministically, not with the LLM.

lessons: Let deterministic code do setup and the LLM do intent.
